//: Context compression policy for KERNEL TRAIL build agents. See docs/06-AGENT-TOOLCHAIN.md section 3 for the reasoning behind every rule here. IMPORTANT: these field names are this project's policy vocabulary, NOT Headroom's configuration schema. Map them to the real schema by reading Headroom's documentation. Do not guess field names.
modeNote: Stays shadow until the fidelity canary in tests/toolchain/headroom.canary.test.ts passes. Shadow measures what would have been compressed without changing what the model receives.

neverCompress.contentPatternsNote: A chapter citation, a high precision decimal, or a named scheduling metric marks content whose exact value is the point. Paraphrasing any of it produces fabricated test vectors that the agent will then write passing tests against.
neverCompress.toolOutputsNote: Small, and they are the signal the agent acts on. Compressing them saves nothing and can hide a failure.

compressible.minLinesNote: Below this the overhead and the risk exceed the saving.

reversibility.note: Every compressed span must be retrievable in full. A golden log is additionally reproducible from its seed, so the cache is a convenience rather than the system of record.
